sentences.text:
------------
 Adv. Ritesh M. Thobde a/w Adv. Changdev Shingade a/w
 Adv. Nitesh Pandey for the Applicant.
Mr. S. V. Gavand, App for the State.

------------
 CORAM : M. S. KARNIK, J.
DATE : JANUARY 20, 2023 P.C. :
1. Heard learned counsel for the applicant and learned APP for the State.
2.

This is an application for pre-arrest bail in respect of an offence punishable under Sections 376(2)(n), 313, 420, 323, 504, 506 read with 34 of the Indian Penal Code,
1860 in connection with C.R. No.78 of 2021 dated 17/02/2021, registered with Manpada Police Station, Thane.
3. Prima facie, it appears that the relationship between the applicant and the prosecutrix was consensual in nature.
The applicant is presently in Iraq.
Learned counsel for the Darshan Patil 906-aba-181-23.doc applicant submits that the applicant is willing to cooperate with the investigation.
The charge-sheet has been filed against other accused who are related to the applicant.

4. In the meantime, in the event of arrest in connection with C.R. No.78 of 2021 dated 17/02/2021,
registered with Manpada Police Station, Thane, applicant- Mohammad Gaus Ali, shall be released Mohammad Gaus Ali vs State Of Maharashtra on 20 January, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/74584928/
1 on bail on furnishing P.R. bond to the extent of Rs.25,000/- with one or more sureties of the like amount.
